units.function: Mocked route tests intended to prevent assigned top-level or parent-blocking child Work from becoming an unwoken backlog leaf while preserving explicitly parked assigned backlog.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest -> Issue creation routes -> mocked Agent resolution, Issue creation, wakeup and activity services; board authorization is universally allowed.
units.keyDataModels: Issue status/assignee, parent blocker relationship, assignment wake request and activity metadata describing defaulted or explicit status.
units.lifecycle: Create assigned Work -> reject ambiguous missing status or default to todo -> optionally block parent -> wake Agent -> log creation; explicit backlog creates parked Work and skips wake.
units.testAssessment: Sandboxed run failed 3/3 on TCP bind; approved unsandboxed run passed 3/3. The first two tests accept either rejection or auto-activation, so they do not establish a single stable contract; all persistence/wakeup/audit behavior is mocked.
units.designRationale: Avoid liveness loops caused by assigning executable or parent-blocking Work into backlog without notifying its Agent, while retaining intentional parking.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must distinguish assigning responsibility, accepting work and activating execution so no implicit default starts an Agent or leaves blocking work inert without an accountable decision.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT with explicit assignmentDisposition/activation intent and one canonical validation rule. Persist Work, responsibility assignment, activation decision and mandatory outbox atomically; bind initiator/accountable human, Agent eligibility/capacity, risk/budget policy, idempotency and delivery status. Retain explicit parked-versus-active audit reasons and parent-blocker liveness checks.
units.responsibilityConflict: The test permits implicit auto-start or rejection for identical input and does not bind wakeup to an accountable human or durable transaction. Assignment alone must not silently imply authority to execute.
evidence: git history: 8 commits from 53f09cb818b934beadc2a58897604c9ddca1d42e through e400315cbf3cf0a69e5820efd6bafbc81bf8d7ae recorded in read ledger

units.securityFindings: HIGH ambiguous execution authority: identical input may reject or auto-activate. HIGH atomicity gap: Issue, wake and audit are independent mocks. HIGH responsibility gap: no accountable human or Agent acceptance. MEDIUM idempotency gap: duplicate create/wake is untested. MEDIUM eligibility gap: assignee resolver always reports active/healthy. MEDIUM liveness gap: wake delivery failure/retry and parent-blocker rollback are absent.
